concept.description: Method executing inside a transaction (label :Transactional). Provided by the technology packs.
Method executing inside a read-only transaction (label :ReadOnlyTransactional).
Method sending a message to a broker (label :BrokerSend).

constraint.description: Non-rollbackable side effects (broker send, mail, remote call) must run after commit (outbox / @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT)), not inside a transaction.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(tx:Method:Transactional)-[:INVOKES*1..3]->(effect:Method:SideEffectCall) WHERE NOT t:Test RETURN DISTINCT tx AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, effect.signature AS Detail

constraint.description: A read-only transaction must not reach a repository write: remove readOnly=true or move the write to a read-write transaction.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(tx:Method:ReadOnlyTransactional)-[:INVOKES*0..3]->(w:Method:RepositoryWrite) WHERE NOT t:Test RETURN DISTINCT tx AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, w.signature AS Detail

constraint.description: CPU/memory heavy or blocking work and outbound calls keep the transaction (and its connection) open: run them outside the transaction.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(tx:Method:Transactional)-[:INVOKES*1..3]->(heavy:Method) WHERE NOT t:Test AND (heavy:HeavyWork OR heavy:OutboundCall) AND NOT heavy:SideEffectCall RETURN DISTINCT tx AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, heavy.signature AS Detail

constraint.description: Broker sends must go through the outbox relay types (parameter outboxTypeRegex) so that they are published atomically with the business transaction.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(send:Method:BrokerSend) WHERE NOT t:Test AND NOT t.fqn =~ $outboxTypeRegex RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, send.signature AS Detail
